WITH lead_context AS (
  SELECT
    l.id AS lead_id, l.whatsapp_name, l.phone_number, l.service, l.city, l.requirement,
    l.clickup_task_id, l.clickup_task_url,
    s.id AS seller_id, s.name AS seller_name, s.whatsapp_number AS seller_whatsapp_number,
    s.clickup_user_id,
    'seller-notification:lead:' || l.id::text || ':seller:' || s.id::text AS operation_key
  FROM leads l
  JOIN sellers s ON s.id = l.assigned_seller_id
  WHERE l.id = $1::bigint AND l.deleted_at IS NULL
),
ambiguous_stale AS (
  UPDATE external_operations eo
  SET status='unknown', reconciliation_required=TRUE,
      reconciliation_reason=COALESCE(eo.reconciliation_reason, 'stale_processing_without_provider_result'),
      retry_safe=FALSE, updated_at=NOW()
  FROM lead_context lc
  WHERE eo.operation_key=lc.operation_key AND eo.status='processing'
    AND eo.locked_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
  RETURNING eo.*, FALSE AS claimed_now
),
operation_seed AS (
  INSERT INTO external_operations (
    operation_key, operation_type, entity_type, entity_id, status,
    attempt_count, locked_at, request_payload
  )
  SELECT operation_key, 'seller_notification', 'lead', lead_id, 'processing', 1, NOW(),
    jsonb_build_object('seller_id', seller_id, 'clickup_task_id', clickup_task_id)
  FROM lead_context
  ON CONFLICT (operation_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING *, TRUE AS claimed_now
),
operation_claim AS (
  UPDATE external_operations eo
  SET status='processing', attempt_count=eo.attempt_count+1, locked_at=NOW(),
      reconciliation_required=FALSE, reconciliation_reason=NULL, retry_safe=FALSE,
      last_error=NULL, updated_at=NOW()
  FROM lead_context lc
  WHERE eo.operation_key=lc.operation_key
    AND (eo.status='pending' OR (eo.status='failed' AND eo.retry_safe=TRUE))
  RETURNING eo.*, TRUE AS claimed_now
),
effective_operation AS (
  SELECT * FROM ambiguous_stale
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM operation_seed
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM operation_claim
  UNION ALL
  SELECT eo.*, FALSE AS claimed_now
  FROM external_operations eo JOIN lead_context lc ON lc.operation_key=eo.operation_key
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ambiguous_stale)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM operation_seed)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM operation_claim)
)
SELECT lc.*,
  eo.status AS notification_operation_status,
  eo.reconciliation_required AS notification_reconciliation_required,
  eo.reconciliation_reason AS notification_reconciliation_reason,
  (eo.status='processing' AND eo.claimed_now) AS should_dispatch_notification
FROM lead_context lc
JOIN effective_operation eo ON TRUE;

WITH operation_update AS (
  UPDATE external_operations eo
  SET status = CASE
        WHEN $10::boolean THEN eo.status
        WHEN $7::text='succeeded' THEN 'succeeded'
        WHEN $7::text='unknown' THEN 'unknown'
        ELSE 'failed'
      END,
      completed_at=CASE WHEN $7::text='succeeded' THEN COALESCE(eo.completed_at,NOW()) ELSE eo.completed_at END,
      reconciliation_required=$8::boolean,
      reconciliation_reason=CASE WHEN $8::boolean THEN 'Provider outcome unknown; manual reconciliation required' ELSE NULL END,
      retry_safe=$9::boolean,
      response_payload=COALESCE(NULLIF($5::text,'')::jsonb,'{}'::jsonb),
      updated_at=NOW()
  WHERE eo.operation_key=$11::text
  RETURNING eo.id
),
updated_lead AS (
  UPDATE leads l
  SET lead_status_id=CASE WHEN $8::boolean OR $10::boolean THEN l.lead_status_id ELSE ls.id END,
      updated_at=NOW()
  FROM lead_statuses ls
  WHERE l.id=$1::bigint
    AND ls.code=CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN 'notified' ELSE 'error' END
  RETURNING l.id
),
audit_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_logs (event_name,entity_type,entity_id,actor_type,actor_id,result,before_payload,after_payload,metadata)
  SELECT $3::text,'lead',ul.id,'system','n8n',$4::text,'{}'::jsonb,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($5::text,'')::jsonb,'{}'::jsonb),COALESCE(NULLIF($6::text,'')::jsonb,'{}'::jsonb)
  FROM updated_lead ul RETURNING id
)
SELECT ul.id AS lead_id, ai.id AS audit_id, ou.id AS operation_id
FROM updated_lead ul
LEFT JOIN audit_insert ai ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN operation_update ou ON TRUE;
